summation.displayName: Hyperphosphorylated IRAK1, still within the receptor complex...
summation.text: Hyperphosphorylated IRAK1, still within the receptor complex, binds TRAF6 through multiple regions including the death domain, the undefined domain and the C-terminal C1 domain (Li et al. 2001). The C-terminal region of IRAK-1 contains three potential TRAF6-binding sites; mutation of the amino acids (Glu544, Glu587, Glu706) in these sites to alanine greatly reduces activation of NFkappaB (Ye et al. 2002).
